ticket.title: a task scoped only by crate name cannot reach its repository verification chain, so it certifies at cargo test and its receipt names no repository
ticket.description: Measured 2026-11-10 while verifying SP-49 itself. The ticket was scoped crate_name storypole-cli with no repository, which is the normal shape for a crate-level finding. Chain lookup is exact by crate key, then exact by repository key, then the default key; storypole-cli has no entry, the task names no repository so the repository lookup is skipped, and storypole config declares no default entry. The result was the cargo-test fallback: receipt command cargo test, chain_key none, repo none, verifier storypole-verify:cargo-test-fallback, on a repository that does configure a full storypole chain the whole time. The warning and the fallback marker both fired, so the receipt was honest rather than silently weak - the defect is that the chain was unreachable, not that the weakness went unreported. Two consequences: a crate-scoped ticket silently certifies at cargo test even when its repository has fmt+clippy+nextest+audit+docs configured, and the receipt cannot say which repository it measured because scope.repo is what supplies that field. Wanted: resolve the crate to its owning repository through the workspace topology before declaring no chain, and stamp the receipt with the resolved repository. Acceptance: a task scoped only by crate_name storypole-cli reaches the storypole chain, its receipt names repo storypole and chain_key storypole, and a crate no member owns still reports the fallback honestly.
